scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Must have applied for a full-time undergraduate degree; Outstanding academic achievement (equivalent to A*AA at A-Level); Separate scholarship application required; Must demonstrate commitment to becoming an ambassador for Bangor University.
scholarships.description: A highly competitive award for the most exceptional international applicants. The scholarship provides a total of £10,000 (split over the duration of the course) to recognize and reward academic excellence and leadership.

scholarships.name: International Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Automatic assessment based on admission application; Hold a 2:1 or 1st class honors degree (or international equivalent); Must be a self-funding student; Available for most taught Master's programs.
scholarships.description: An automatic merit-based award for international postgraduates. The value of the scholarship is determined by the applicant's prior academic performance, with higher awards given to those with first-class degrees.
